ci_method: Exact Clopper-Pearson binomial interval on well-level directions among determinate wells (wells independent, one last result per well per period)
independent_unit: The well (monitoring location): one last routine result per well per period, so repeated and temporally close samples within a well are collapsed. Wells are treated as independent although neighbouring wells share aquifers and USGS programs (spatial dependence not modelled).
nondetect_sensitivity: Substitution used only as a labelled sensitivity check (decline/increase/tie): zero (149, 108, 38), half-limit (153, 107, 35), full-limit (152, 108, 35). Direction (more declines than increases or not) per substitution: zero: declines>increases, half: declines>increases, full: declines>increases. Primary classification uses intervals [0,DL] for non-detects.
notes: Share declining among all cohort wells = 0.495 (146/295); 44 wells indeterminate and not counted as either direction. Median ratio over 257 both-detected wells, well-bootstrap 95% CI [0.93,1.00]. Reporting limits varied 0.09-20 ug/L over time; the 2012 limit of 20 ug/L is elevated. Last-result sample dates differ by well, so the interval between paired results varies. A 20%-change tolerance variant gives {'indeterminate': 212, 'decline': 57, 'increase': 26}.
checks: cohort composition: 295 wells in both periods
excluded QC replicates, 'Not determined' activity types, non-groundwater subdivisions (elutriation, soil moisture, interstitial, leachate) and total As (01002)
unit: all ug/l; no re-expressed pairs for As (single parameter code)
no duplicate (well,period) keys after last-result selection
caveats: Wells selected for repeat sampling are not a random sample of the county
Spatial dependence between wells not modelled
Detected values treated as exact; analytical error ignored
